data.long_name: Air temperature at 2 m

data.long_name: Dew point at 2 m

data.name: relative_humidity
data.long_name: Relative humidity at 2 m
data.notes: Computed from air temperature and dew point (the Magnus formula, over water).

data.name: wind_speed
data.long_name: Wind speed at 10 m

data.name: wind_gust

data.name: surface_pressure
data.long_name: Surface pressure

data.name: cloud_cover
data.long_name: Total cloud cover

data.name: precipitation
data.long_name: Precipitation in the hour ending at the time
data.notes: The total for the hour ending at the time.

data.name: shortwave_radiation_hrrr
data.long_name: HRRR's downward shortwave radiation at the surface, mean over the hour, uncorrected
data.notes: HRRR's solar radiation before our correction to ground measurements. It reads about 18% high.

data.name: shortwave_radiation
data.long_name: Downward shortwave radiation at the surface, mean over the hour
data.notes: Corrected to pyranometers on the ground. Daily totals are in MJ/m² (W/m² × 0.0036).

data.name: soil_temperature_4cm
data.long_name: Soil temperature at 4 cm
data.notes: Taken from the source's soil layers (0–7, 7–28 and 28–100 cm) to the depth. The potato models' 2 inch depth.

data.name: soil_temperature_10cm
data.long_name: Soil temperature at 10 cm
data.notes: Taken from the source's soil layers (0–7, 7–28 and 28–100 cm) to the depth. The potato models' 4 inch depth.

data.name: soil_temperature_30cm
data.long_name: Soil temperature at 30 cm
data.notes: Taken from the source's soil layers (0–7, 7–28 and 28–100 cm) to the depth. With 10 cm, it gives the potato models' 8 inch depth.

data.name: snow_depth
data.long_name: Snow depth
data.notes: The depth of the snow itself, not its water content.

data.name: soil_moisture_0_to_7cm
data.long_name: Soil moisture, 0 to 7 cm
data.notes: The volume of water in the soil from 0 to 7 cm, as a share of the soil's volume (0.30 is 30%), for the model's soil, not a field's. Includes frozen water.

data.name: soil_moisture_7_to_28cm
data.long_name: Soil moisture, 7 to 28 cm
data.notes: The volume of water in the soil from 7 to 28 cm, as a share of the soil's volume (0.30 is 30%), for the model's soil, not a field's. Includes frozen water.

data.name: soil_moisture_28_to_100cm
data.long_name: Soil moisture, 28 to 100 cm
data.notes: The volume of water in the soil from 28 to 100 cm, as a share of the soil's volume (0.30 is 30%), for the model's soil, not a field's. Includes frozen water.

data.name: et0
data.long_name: FAO-56 grass reference evapotranspiration in the hour
data.notes: Grass reference evapotranspiration by the FAO-56 Penman-Monteith equation, computed each hour.

data.name: thi
data.long_name: Temperature humidity index
data.notes: The National Research Council's (1971) temperature humidity index, from air temperature and relative humidity. Dairy cattle's milk yield begins to fall at 68; 72 is commonly taken as heat stress.

data.name: cci
data.long_name: Cattle comfort index
data.notes: Mader, Johnson and Gaughan's (2010) comprehensive climate index: air temperature adjusted for humidity, wind (taken from 10 m to 2 m) and solar radiation, as an apparent temperature.
